selection: Among all twelve preregistered independent births, sort by the stored developmental validation score, break ties by numeric birth seed, choose the lower middle position (index 5). No external outcome is used to select the specimen.
default_lifetime_rule: Use the same uncertainty-direction reopening amplitude precommitted for the independent birth replication in every game, including short transfer and long changing streams.
archive: A NumPy inference checkpoint and native closed-loop game demo; verify in a separate extracted directory without PyTorch.
